name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.mutual.SpeechVoiceQuestionActivity
description: This older Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK screen appears for question-based voice ads. It shows an advertiser-related question and answer choices, then guides the user through a spoken answer check.
disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the spoken question step from running, so users cannot complete that rewarded ad or receive its reward.
